about.story1: Tion Play was born in the summer of 2023 in Istanbul, Turkey. Fatih Aytar, a software developer with a lifelong passion for games, decided to stop dreaming and start building.
about.story2: The studio's name comes from an unlikely muse: Fatih's cat, Tion. Curious, precise, and impossible to ignore — the perfect spirit animal for a precision game studio.
about.story3: Working from a home office in Istanbul, with Tion occasionally walking across the keyboard, Tion Play has crafted games that celebrate the satisfaction of perfect timing.
about.mission: To make games that feel like art — accessible to everyone, deeply satisfying to master, and worth every minute of your time.

tapstop.tagline: Tap at the perfect moment — across 10 different challenges!
tapstop.description: TapStop is a precision timing mobile game featuring 10 completely different mini-game mechanics. Each level puts your reflexes to a brand-new test: fill a glass without spilling, cut fruit in half, inflate a balloon without popping it, rescue a princess past a sleeping bear, and much more. 100 hand-crafted levels, 6 stunning visual themes, buttery-smooth 60fps — and completely free.
tapstop.mechanicsSub: Each mechanic is unique — master them all to conquer all 100 levels.

tap.name: Fill the Glass
tap.desc: Stop the faucet at exactly the right moment. Don't spill a drop!

fruitcut.name: Cut the Fruit
fruitcut.desc: Slice the watermelon perfectly in half with one precise tap.

balloon.name: Inflate Balloon
balloon.desc: Pump the balloon as big as possible — without popping it.

pizza.name: Bake Pizza
pizza.desc: Pull the pizza from the oven at the perfect golden moment.

princess.name: Rescue Princess
princess.desc: Sneak past the sleeping bear without waking it.

scissors.name: Cut the Hair
scissors.desc: Snip at exactly the right moment to nail the perfect cut.

fish.name: Catch Fish
fish.desc: Reel in the fish at just the right moment — not too early, not too late.

boomerang.name: Catch Boomerang
boomerang.desc: Catch it just as it returns to your hand.

bag.name: Steal the Bag
bag.desc: Grab grandpa's bag without making a sound.

crossy.name: Cross the Road
crossy.desc: Time your crossing perfectly to avoid getting hit.
